title: Smoky Skillet Mackerel
description: A smoky twist on a classic Italian-inspired mackerel dish, cooked to perfection in a skillet.

ingredients.name: italian seasoning
ingredients.notes: a blend of herbs and spices

ingredients.name: skillet
ingredients.notes: preferably cast iron or stainless steel

instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the mackerel fillets with salt, pepper, and italian seasoning.
Add the olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Sear the mackerel fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Remove the mackerel from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced yellow onion to the skillet and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the smoky paprika over the onion and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the mackerel on top of the onion and paprika mixture.
